phenomenon: opaque procedure indices stay lexical; literal counts segment
notes: Both halves of the prompt's OPAQUE INDEX TEST in one item. The P-family numerals select unrelated stored procedures and contribute no quantity, so P1..P4 are whole lexemes; the x-family numerals contribute their literal count, so x3/x5/x8 are OPERATOR + COUNT. Segmenting P* fails precision, leaving x3 whole fails recall. Sized so the degradation gate cannot rescue a wrong answer: four segmented P-codes is well past the two-code threshold.
